31. ... R — K 8 ch
32. R × R R × R ch
33. K — R 2 B — B 2
34. K — Kt 3 P — Q 4

the quickest way to finish the game.

35. B × P P × P ch
36. K — Kt 4 P — B 6
37. P × P R — K 5 ch
38. P — B 4 R × P ch
39. K — R 5 R × B
40. R — Q 8 ch K — R 2
41. R — Q 7 B — K 3
Resigns.

A very lively game.

GAME 14. QUEEN'S GAMBIT DECLINED
(New York, 1918)

White: F. J. Marshall. Black: J. R. Capablanca.

1. P — Q 4 P — Q 4
2. Kt — K B 3 Kt — K B 3
3. P — B 4 P — K 3
4. Kt — B 3 Q Kt — Q 2
5. B — Kt 5 B — K 2
6. P — K 3 O — O
7. R — B 1 P — B 3

This is one of the oldest systems of defence against the Queen's Gambit. I had played it before in this Tournament against Kostic, and no doubt Marshall expected it. At times I change my defences,
